basis: R1489 shows SIMD format branch misses increasing with fewer retired instructions, while AArch64 losses occur with fewer branch misses. The next boundary is locating the cost and testing whether fetch events are observable.
method: Require the observed N2 CPU identity for raw-event interpretation. Retain acceptance, counts, zero counters and running percentages on two Python workloads. Separately test cycle and branch-miss sampling and perf-script output before any candidate profiling workflow.
limits: Accepted raw events with all-zero counts are not usable evidence of absent misses. This preflight does not measure Capstone performance or prove a cache cause.
